name: SLIM 3D
notes: SLIM tetramer, full 3-D, authored natively as inline extruded shapes (no geometry files). Axes: x = transport (37 mm), y = board gap (mirror axis; half-domain 0..2.05 mm with grid.mirror='y' giving two boards and a 2.75 mm gap between inner faces at y = ±1.375 mm), z = board width (13 mm, five rungs). RF rails confine across the gap; travelling DC rungs carry ions along x.
